target: Equivalent bounded read-only CLI, loopback HTTP, and MCP memory access plus explicit update-channel and summary-budget governance.
primary_semantics: All public readers share one provenance-aware query service; update selection and summary eligibility are deterministic, reviewable, and unable to install software or invoke AI by themselves.
invariants: Raw history and derived memory artifacts remain unchanged by every read interface and scheduler eligibility check.
CLI, HTTP, and MCP use the same request validation, result bounds, confidence labels, provenance fields, and raw verification path.
HTTP binds only to loopback and MCP exposes only allow-listed read methods.
Downloaded updates remain staged evidence until a separate explicit user approval invokes an existing installer.
The summary scheduler may enqueue one-shot semantic work only at a completed dialogue-round boundary and never invokes AI itself.
allowed_changes: Add a shared bounded read-only query service and thin CLI, loopback HTTP, and MCP adapters.
Add stable, beta, and development update metadata selection with verified delta-to-full fallback.
Add deterministic summary-budget eligibility and queue dispatch.
Add provenance, malformed-request, unavailable-source, stale-index, fallback, and boundary tests.
prohibited_changes: Expose write, delete, pairing, installation, remote-control, arbitrary filesystem, or arbitrary command methods through CLI, HTTP, or MCP.
Install or execute a downloaded update without a separate explicit approval action.
Represent an index-only or summary-only match as an exact quotation.
Invoke AI during query validation, update selection, or mechanical summary eligibility checks.
before_after_checks: Hash raw fixtures before and after every CLI, HTTP, MCP, and scheduler case.
Compare normalized success and error payloads across all three read adapters.
Inject malformed, over-broad, stale-index, and missing-raw cases and verify fail-closed confidence.
Exercise stable, beta, development, signature/hash failure, delta failure, full fallback, and rollback metadata.
Exercise every summary threshold immediately before, at, and after a completed-round boundary without an AI call.
